storyHeading: A trip plan adults can stand behind
storyParagraphs: Getting approval for a student trip means answering practical questions before anyone boards a bus. Where will the group stay? How will meals work? Which visits support the syllabus? Comfort Journey helps principals, teachers, trip coordinators and parents work through those details before the itinerary is confirmed.

Founded in Bhopal by Sharad Kumar Mishra in 1992, Comfort Journey has spent decades planning travel for groups and families. You can discuss private cabs with drivers, hotel choices from 3-star to 5-star, or palaces and villas where they suit the group and route.

Students get something to talk about after class: a fort they can walk through, a city whose history feels close, or a landscape that makes a lesson stick. Adults get transparent pricing shared upfront and a real person on WhatsApp or phone 24/7 during the trip.

quickAnswer.question: How do I choose school educational tour packages?
quickAnswer.answer: Choose the learning aim first, then compare travel time, hotel level, meals, supervision needs, entry tickets and total cost. Comfort Journey can customise the itinerary for a school or college group, share pricing upfront and support coordinators on WhatsApp or phone 24/7 during the trip. Ask for a route that fits your approval process.

faqs.q: How can a school start planning an educational tour?
faqs.a: Share your preferred dates, departure city, student age group, approximate group size and learning goals on WhatsApp. We can then suggest suitable routes and explain the practical details before you seek final approval.

faqs.q: Which destinations work well for educational tours in India?
faqs.a: Heritage routes such as Gwalior and Orchha, Agra, Jaipur, Varanasi and Madhya Pradesh give students plenty to discuss. Jabalpur and Pachmarhi suit groups looking for nature, geography and outdoor learning.

faqs.q: Can the itinerary be customised for our students?
faqs.a: Yes. Every itinerary can be customised around your dates, learning goals, pace, hotel preference and planned visits. Tell us which stops matter most, and we will shape the route around the group.

faqs.q: How much do school and college trip packages cost?
faqs.a: The price changes with dates, group size, route, hotel level, transport, meals, entry tickets and any custom requests. We share an exact quote on WhatsApp after understanding those details, so your committee can review the real inclusions.

faqs.q: What support is available during a student trip?
faqs.a: A real Comfort Journey team is available on WhatsApp and phone 24/7 during trips. During planning, you can also discuss supervision needs, room arrangements, transport and emergency contact details.

faqs.q: Can you arrange an international educational trip?
faqs.a: Yes, international options such as Singapore can be discussed for suitable groups and schedules. Visa requirements and documents depend on the travellers and destination, and the team provides visa assistance before sharing an exact quote on WhatsApp.

finalHeading: Give your group a trip worth approving
finalText: Tell us the class, dates and learning goals. We will suggest a practical route and share an upfront quote on WhatsApp.
